title: Public image record (data/photos.json)
description: Public copies carry no metadata. Original capture time, GPS and camera stay in _private/originals.json, which is git-ignored.

kind.description: Three layers. photograph: documentary record (preferred for Field Log and memories). print: the Atlas's signature field print made from a photograph (This Week, edition covers, archive, seasonal). plate: an occasional illustrative/editorial graphic (landscape, water, ridge, sun); always provenance editorial.

provenance.description: documentary: taken at place_id on taken_at. archive: real, place unknown or unrelated. editorial: chosen or made for mood; implies no place.

place_id.description: Only for documentary images: where it was actually taken.
